name: Monthly Revenue & Seasonality
description: Tracks revenue and order volume month over month to identify seasonality patterns and improve sales forecasting.

name: Revenue by State
description: Ranks states by total revenue to identify top-performing geographic markets for targeted marketing investment.

name: Revenue by Food Category
description: Breaks down revenue by cuisine category to reveal high-value food segments and guide menu strategy.

name: Quarterly Performance
description: Aggregates sales by quarter for executive-level period-over-period comparison and seasonal planning.

name: Top 20 Dishes by Revenue
description: Identifies highest-revenue dishes to inform menu optimisation, promotions, and restaurant partnership decisions.

name: Top 20 Restaurants by Revenue
description: Highlights top-performing restaurant partners by revenue for strategic account management and co-marketing opportunities.

name: Day of Week Sales Pattern
description: Reveals weekly seasonality to optimise staffing, promotions, and delivery capacity by day of week.

name: Customer Basket Segmentation
description: Segments orders by basket value (Budget / Standard / Premium / Luxury) to identify high-value customer tiers for retention campaigns.

name: Restaurant Frequency Tiers
description: Classifies restaurants by order volume into High / Medium / Low tiers as a proxy for purchase frequency segmentation.

name: Pareto: Cities Driving 80% Revenue
description: Identifies the minimum set of cities that together generate 80% of total revenue (Pareto / 80-20 rule).

name: Restaurant RFM Segmentation
description: Implements restaurant-partner RFM scoring in SQL using recency, frequency, and monetary value as account-retention signals.

name: Restaurant Cohort Retention
description: Builds monthly restaurant-partner cohorts and measures the share that remains active in each later month.
